newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dollar/mark rate can be defended -German official.
newsitem.headline: Dollar/mark rate can be defended -German official.

text.p: A top German finance official said on Monday that the current dollar exchange rate of 1.55 marks was at an appropriate level which could be defended on financial markets.
"This is a parity which can be defended on the financial markets," Michael Roeskau, deputy director general at the German finance ministry, told a conference on economic and monetary union.

Roeskau recalled recent comments by the Bundesbank president, Hans Tietmeyer, who said there was a margin for appreciation of the dollar. He noted that this had happened, saying the dollar had "obeyed".
He said the current dollar-mark exchange rate was not far from its levels three or four years ago before the markets entered a turbulent period. -- Brussels newsroom +322 287 6800
